component.name: PairPaint
component.summary: Layered image editor for photos and painting

description.p: PairPaint is a free, cross-platform image editor with layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer groups and layer styles. It was created through pair programming between a human and an AI.

ul.li: Layers with all Photoshop blend modes, masks, groups, clipping masks and styles (shadow, glow, stroke)
Adjustment layers: Levels, Curves, Exposure, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, White Balance and more
One-click Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color
Brush, Clone Stamp, Spot Healing and Healing Brush, Smudge, Blur, Sharpen, Dodge, Burn, Sponge, gradients, shapes, and text typed on the canvas
Selections with feather, expand, contract and color range; free transform
Opens and saves layered Photoshop PSD files

screenshot.caption: Editing a layered image with text, effects, a group and an adjustment layer

description.p: Opens HEIC photos from iPhones, and shows wide-gamut photos (Display P3, Adobe RGB) with their correct colors.

ul.li: One-click Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color
White Balance, Vibrance, Exposure and Color Balance adjustments and adjustment layers
Quality setting for JPEG and WebP export

description.p: More security fixes: specially crafted files can no longer crash PairPaint or exhaust its memory. Project files are now version 6.
Security and stability fixes: damaged image files found by fuzzing no longer crash or freeze PairPaint.

ul.li: Spot Healing Brush: paint over blemishes, no source point needed
Crop with aspect ratio presets and straightening

description.p: Layer groups and styles, better Photoshop compatibility, and typing text on the canvas.

ul.li: Type and edit text directly on the image
Layer groups, layer styles (drop shadow, outer glow, stroke), clipping masks and Fill opacity
Photoshop files open with their adjustment layers, shape layers, clipping masks and effects
Smudge, Dodge and Burn tools; Feather, Expand, Contract, Border, Smooth and Color Range selections
